subject: AcreetionOS Update — July 12, 2026
body:
Emacs 31.1 has been released, bringing a plethora of changes and improvements to the beloved editor, and our community is already exploring its new features and capabilities. This release is a great reminder of the vibrant ecosystem surrounding AcreetionOS, an Arch-based Linux distribution that thrives on the simplicity and power of its underlying technology.

Development
The recent enhancements to our continuous integration pipeline, including per-pipeline staging directories and relative symlinks for the latest.iso file, have significantly improved the reliability of our ISO build process, ensuring that AcreetionOS remains a cutting-edge distribution. You can learn more about our development process and the latest changes on our changelog page at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html.

Community
Our community has been actively engaged in refining and stabilizing our workflow, and we appreciate the tireless efforts of our contributors. For those looking to get involved, our documentation at https://acreetionos.org/docs.html and wiki guides at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html are great resources to get started. Additionally, you can find the latest news and updates on our website at https://acreetionos.org/, including information on how to flash your device with the latest AcreetionOS image using our flash tool at https://acreetionos.org/flash.html.
